name: City Beautiful Painter

reviewSamples.author: Photo of safy falfala
reviewSamples.text:
I can’t recommend City Beautiful Painter enough! My father-in-law originally recommended him to us, and we’re so glad he did. He initially painted the entire interior of our home, and everything came out absolutely stunning. We were so happy with the quality of his work that we called him back to paint all of our doors and trim as well.

Hands down one of the best painters in Orlando and the surrounding areas. His attention to detail, professionalism, and quality of work are truly unmatched. On top of being incredibly talented at what he does, he’s also just an awesome person to work with professional, reliable, positive, and always brings great energy.

If you’re looking for someone who genuinely cares about the quality of their work and your home, I would highly recommend City Beautiful Painter. We will definitely continue using him for any future painting projects!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Xmen Law
reviewSamples.text: City Beautiful Painter provides a very good service. This is my first time to hire this company to paint my house. The quality is really good and my house looks like a brand new one! Thank Marcello and I appreciate your work well done!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Diego Esteves
reviewSamples.text: I had an amazing experience with Marcello and his team, they completed the job in a timely manner as previously agreed, they were very professional, and did an amazing job with the painting of my entire home. It looks like a brand new home once again.!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Brianna Fuentes
reviewSamples.text: I am so glad I went with Marcello and his crew. I got about 5 quotes as I was looking for great service with reasonable pricing. I was forced to paint my exterior by my HOA and needed it done soon, he was able to get me in within a few weeks. They were professional and courteous. He wasn't pushy at all. Above all did a great paint job. They even helped me move some outdoor furniture because my husband wasn't home. My next project in a few months will definitely be with them to seal my pavers.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Mike Thom
reviewSamples.text:
I moved into a new office space on Wednesday. I called to see if I could get my office painted the very next day (Thursday). They managed to get me an early morning appointment very last minute. Painters were prompt, professional and definitely 5 stars ⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Great service and highly recommend!

Thank You City Beautiful Painter! 💪
